notes: Rebel state added by se-04-x. The MTA pages give no area, no boundary and no dates for the Wa occupation, so the territory is the researcher's placement (Homein and a Thai-border circle shared with wa-state, the latter at confidence 1). Date disagreement: the MTA page says the majority surrendered in 1995, the infobox and the Internal conflict page say 1996 (month unknown in both); the dossier ends 1996. The January 1996 date of Khun Sa's surrender is not on any page opened. Counterparts needing dossiers: shan-state-national-army (1995 onwards). Gazetteer names wanted: Homein / Ho Mong, Kengtung, Mong Hsat (places). Page budget: 4 pages. Repair pass 2026-10-25 (reviewer finding on the SSNA split): ledger/3 and the SSNA successor land now sit at Hsipaw (40 km circle cut to Shan State, confidence 2) instead of the Ho Mong circle that the MTA keeps to 1996; Hsipaw is a coordinate circle because the gazetteer lacks the name (Hsipaw needed as a place, 22.617 N 97.283 E). Disagreement with the reviewer's second option: no page puts MTA ground at Hsipaw, so the keyframes are unchanged and the split records the SSNA's base rather than a region taken out of the keyframes. The Khun Sa page gave the surrender date, 5 January 1996, so contest_end and dissolve now carry month 1 and cite that page; it is silent on when the Wa took the Thai-border country (ledger/4 stays confidence 1). Pages opened in this pass: 3 (Mong Tai Army, Khun Sa, Hsipaw).
